```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
#Our best performing model

#GBM with AdaBoost Loss, Information Gain Feature Selection, and Extensive Hyperparameter and Threshold Tuning
#Best Score: .1395 (on unseen data)

library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(gbm)
library(ROSE)
library(FSelectorRcpp)

set.seed(123)

#Load and prepare full data
full_data <- read.csv("LabelData.csv")
full_data$adopter <- as.factor(full_data$adopter)

#Select top 20 features by Information Gain
ig <- information_gain(adopter ~ ., full_data)
top_k_features <- ig[order(-ig$importance), "attributes"][1:20]

#Only use our top features to build the model and use a numeric target
data <- full_data %>%
  select(all_of(c(top_k_features, "adopter"))) %>%
  mutate(adopter = as.numeric(as.character(adopter)))

#Define grid of hyperparameters (will test over 400 models)
ratios <- c(0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.4)
n_trees <- c(50, 100, 125, 150, 175, 200)
depths <- c(1, 2, 3, 4)
shrinkages <- c(0.03, 0.05, 0.1)
thresholds <- seq(0.25, 0.30, by = 0.005)

#Store best results
final_results <- data.frame()

#Grid search
for (r in ratios) {
  sampled_data <- ovun.sample(adopter ~ ., data = data, method = "under",
                              N = floor(nrow(data) * r), seed = 123)$data
  
  for (n in n_trees) {
    for (d in depths) {
      for (s in shrinkages) {
        
        #Train the model
        gbm_model <- gbm(adopter ~ ., data = sampled_data,
                         distribution = "adaboost",
                         n.trees = n,
                         interaction.depth = d,
                         shrinkage = s,
                         verbose = FALSE)
        
        #Predict probabilities on full data
        probs <- predict(gbm_model, newdata = data, n.trees = n, type = "response")
        
        best_f1 <- 0
        best_thresh <- NA
        
        #Threshold tuning
        for (t in thresholds) {
          preds <- ifelse(probs >= t, 1, 0)
          cm <- confusionMatrix(factor(preds), factor(data$adopter),
                                mode = "prec_recall", positive = "1")
          f1 <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])
          if (is.na(f1)) f1 <- 0
          
          if (f1 > best_f1) {
            best_f1 <- f1
            best_thresh <- t
          }
        }
        
        #Save best combination
        final_results <- bind_rows(final_results,
                                   data.frame(ratio = r,
                                              ntrees = n,
                                              depth = d,
                                              shrinkage = s,
                                              best_threshold = best_thresh,
                                              F1 = best_f1))
        
        cat(sprintf("Ratio: %.2f | Trees: %d | Depth: %d | LR: %.3f | F1: %.4f | Threshold: %.3f\n",
                    r, n, d, s, best_f1, best_thresh))
      }
    }
  }
}

#Show top results
final_results <- final_results %>% arrange(desc(F1))
final_results

#Get best model configuration
best <- final_results[which.max(final_results$F1), ]
best_ratio <- best$ratio
best_ntrees <- best$ntrees
best_depth <- best$depth
best_shrink <- best$shrinkage
best_thresh <- best$best_threshold

cat("\nBest Model: Ratio =", best_ratio,
    "| Trees =", best_ntrees,
    "| Depth =", best_depth,
    "| Shrinkage =", best_shrink,
    "| Threshold =", best_thresh,
    "| F1 =", round(best$F1, 4), "\n")

#Recreate training data 
best_sampled <- ovun.sample(adopter ~ ., data = data, method = "under",
                            N = floor(nrow(data) * best_ratio), seed = 123)$data

#Retrain GBM on best sample
final_gbm <- gbm(adopter ~ ., data = best_sampled,
                 distribution = "adaboost",
                 n.trees = best_ntrees,
                 interaction.depth = best_depth,
                 shrinkage = best_shrink,
                 verbose = FALSE)

#Load UnlabelData and select same the features
unlabeled <- read.csv("UnlabelData.csv")
unlabeled_subset <- unlabeled %>% select(all_of(top_k_features))

#Predict and apply best threshold
unlabeled_probs <- predict(final_gbm, newdata = unlabeled_subset, 
                           n.trees = best_ntrees, type = "response")
unlabeled_preds <- ifelse(unlabeled_probs >= best_thresh, 1, 0)

#Export to CSV
submission <- data.frame(Id = 1:nrow(unlabeled), Predicted = unlabeled_preds)
write.csv(submission, "Team13-Submission-X", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#GBM with AdaBoost Loss (using Undersampling + IG) 
#Score: .1348 (on unseen data)

library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(gbm)
library(ROSE)
library(FSelectorRcpp)

set.seed(123)

#Load labeled data
data <- read.csv("LabelData.csv")
data$adopter <- as.factor(data$adopter)

#Ensure character predictors are converted to factors
data <- data %>% mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)

#Compute Information Gain and select top 20 features
ig_scores <- information_gain(adopter ~ ., data)
top_features_ig <- ig_scores %>%
  arrange(desc(importance)) %>%
  slice(1:20) %>%
  pull(attributes)

#Subset data to top features
data <- data %>%
  select(all_of(c(top_features_ig, "adopter"))) %>%
  mutate(adopter = as.numeric(as.character(adopter)))

#Undersample the data using ROSE
sampled_data <- ovun.sample(adopter ~ ., data = data, method = "under",
                            N = floor(nrow(data) * 0.2), seed = 123)$data

#Train GBM with AdaBoost loss
gbm_model <- gbm(adopter ~ ., data = sampled_data,
                 distribution = "adaboost",
                 n.trees = 150,
                 interaction.depth = 3,
                 shrinkage = 0.05,
                 verbose = FALSE)

#Predict on full labeled data
probs <- predict(gbm_model, newdata = data, n.trees = 150, type = "response")

#Micro-tune threshold from 0.28 to 0.32
thresholds <- seq(0.28, 0.32, by = 0.005)
results <- data.frame()
best_f1 <- 0
best_thresh <- 0

for (thresh in thresholds) {
  preds <- ifelse(probs >= thresh, 1, 0)
  cm <- confusionMatrix(factor(preds), factor(data$adopter), mode = "prec_recall", positive = "1")
  f1 <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])
  if (is.na(f1)) f1 <- 0

  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(threshold = thresh, F1 = f1))

  if (f1 > best_f1) {
    best_f1 <- f1
    best_thresh <- thresh
  }

  cat("Threshold:", thresh, "| F1:", round(f1, 4), "\n")
}

#Show best threshold
print("==== Best Threshold Found ====")
print(results[which.max(results$F1), ])

#Prepare test set with same IG features
test_data <- read.csv("UnlabelData.csv") %>% select(all_of(top_features_ig))

#Predict on test set using best threshold
test_probs <- predict(gbm_model, newdata = test_data, n.trees = 150, type = "response")
test_preds <- ifelse(test_probs > best_thresh, 1, 0)

#Save submission
write.csv(data.frame(user_id = read.csv("UnlabelData.csv")$user_id,
                     adopter = test_preds), "Team-13-Submission-4.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#GBM with AdaBoost Loss, Information Gain Feature Selection, and  Grid Search for Hyperparameters and Threshold (Undersample)
#Score: .1258 (on unseen data)

library(dplyr)
library(gbm)
library(caret)
library(ROSE)
library(FSelectorRcpp)

set.seed(123)

#Load and prepare data
full_data <- read.csv("LabelData.csv")
full_data$adopter <- as.factor(full_data$adopter)

#Convert character variables to factors
full_data <- full_data %>% mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)

#Compute Information Gain and select top 20 features
ig_scores <- information_gain(adopter ~ ., full_data)
ig_scores <- as_tibble(ig_scores)

top_features_ig <- ig_scores %>%
  arrange(desc(importance)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:20) %>%        
  pull(attributes)


#Prepare data with numeric target and selected features
data <- full_data %>%
  select(all_of(c(top_features_ig, "adopter"))) %>%
  mutate(adopter = as.numeric(as.character(adopter)))

#Undersample using ROSE
sampled_data <- ovun.sample(adopter ~ ., data = data, method = "under",
                            N = floor(nrow(data) * 0.2), seed = 123)$data

#Manual Grid Search: GBM hyperparameters and threshold
param_grid <- expand.grid(
  n.trees = c(100, 150, 200),
  depth = c(2, 3, 4),
  shrink = c(0.05, 0.1)
)

thresholds <- seq(0.1, 0.4, by = 0.01)
results <- data.frame()
best_f1 <- 0
best_model <- NULL
best_params <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(param_grid)) {
  trees <- param_grid$n.trees[i]
  depth <- param_grid$depth[i]
  shrink <- param_grid$shrink[i]

  model <- gbm(adopter ~ ., data = sampled_data,
               distribution = "adaboost",
               n.trees = trees,
               interaction.depth = depth,
               shrinkage = shrink,
               verbose = FALSE)

  probs <- predict(model, newdata = data, n.trees = trees, type = "response")

  for (thresh in thresholds) {
    preds <- ifelse(probs >= thresh, 1, 0)
    cm <- confusionMatrix(factor(preds), factor(data$adopter), mode = "prec_recall", positive = "1")
    f1 <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])
    if (is.na(f1)) f1 <- 0

    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      n.trees = trees,
      depth = depth,
      shrink = shrink,
      threshold = thresh,
      F1 = f1
    ))

    if (f1 > best_f1) {
      best_f1 <- f1
      best_model <- model
      best_params <- list(n.trees = trees, depth = depth, shrink = shrink, threshold = thresh)
    }
  }
}

cat("Best Parameters and Threshold\n")
print(best_params)
print(best_f1)

#Load and prepare test data
unlabel_data <- read.csv("UnlabelData.csv")
unlabel_data <- unlabel_data %>% select(all_of(top_features_ig))

#Predict using best model and optimal settings
unlabel_probs <- predict(best_model, newdata = unlabel_data, 
                         n.trees = best_params$n.trees, type = "response")

#Apply threshold and save predictions
unlabel_preds <- ifelse(unlabel_probs >= best_params$threshold, 1, 0)

output <- data.frame(ID = 1:nrow(unlabel_data), adopter = unlabel_preds)
write.csv(output, "Team13-Submission-X.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
#XGBoost + RF + Threshold Tuning + Parameter Tuning + IG (with ROSE undersampling)
#F-1 score was 12.33 on unseen data
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(randomForest)
library(xgboost)
library(FSelectorRcpp)
library(ROSE)

set.seed(123)

#Load and Filter
data <- read.csv("LabelData.csv")
data <- data[, !(names(data) %in% c("user_id"))]
data$adopter <- as.factor(data$adopter)
data <- data %>% mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)

#Compute Information Gain
ig_scores <- information_gain(adopter ~ ., data)
ig_scores <- as_tibble(ig_scores)

top_features_ig <- ig_scores %>%
  arrange(desc(importance)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:20) %>%
  pull(attributes)

#Keep only top IG features
valid_features <- intersect(top_features_ig, names(data))
data <- data[, c(valid_features, "adopter")]

#ROSE undersampling
minority_n <- sum(data$adopter == "1")
train_us <- ovun.sample(adopter ~ ., data = data, method = "under", 
                        N = 2 * minority_n, seed = 123)$data
train_us$adopter <- as.factor(train_us$adopter)

#Prepare copies
data_xgb <- data
train_us_xgb <- train_us
train_us_xgb$adopter <- as.numeric(as.character(train_us_xgb$adopter))
data_xgb$adopter <- as.numeric(as.character(data_xgb$adopter))

#Loop through ntree, nrounds, and thresholds
ntree_vals <- c(50, 100, 200)
nrounds_vals <- c(50, 100, 200)
thresholds <- c(0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6)
results <- data.frame()

for (ntree in ntree_vals) {
  for (nround in nrounds_vals) {
    for (thresh in thresholds) {
      
      #Train Random Forest
      rf_model <- randomForest(adopter ~ ., data = train_us, ntree = ntree)
      rf_prob <- predict(rf_model, newdata = data, type = "prob")[, "1"]

      #Train XGBoost
      x_train <- as.matrix(train_us_xgb %>% select(-adopter))
      y_train <- train_us_xgb$adopter
      x_test <- as.matrix(data_xgb %>% select(-adopter))
      y_test <- data_xgb$adopter

      dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_train, label = y_train)
      dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_test)

      xgb_model <- xgboost(data = dtrain,
                           objective = "binary:logistic",
                           nrounds = nround,
                           max_depth = 5,
                           eta = 0.1,
                           eval_metric = "logloss",
                           verbose = 0)

      xgb_prob <- predict(xgb_model, dtest)

      #Create the ensemble and Evaluate
      avg_prob <- (rf_prob + xgb_prob) / 2
      pred <- ifelse(avg_prob > thresh, 1, 0)

      cm <- confusionMatrix(factor(pred, levels = c(0,1)),
                            factor(y_test, levels = c(0,1)),
                            mode = "prec_recall", positive = "1")
      f1 <- cm$byClass["F1"]

      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(ntree = ntree, nround = nround, threshold = thresh, F1 = f1))
      cat("ntree =", ntree, "| nround =", nround, "| threshold =", thresh, "| F1 =", round(f1, 4), "\n")
    }
  }
}

#View Best Result
best <- results[which.max(results$F1), ]
print(best)

#Load Unlabeled Data and Prepare for Submission
unlabeled <- read.csv("UnlabelData.csv")
user_ids <- unlabeled$user_id
unlabeled <- unlabeled[, valid_features]

#Train final models on full labeled data
final_rf <- randomForest(adopter ~ ., data = train_us, ntree = best$ntree)
rf_pred <- predict(final_rf, newdata = unlabeled, type = "prob")[, "1"]

#XGBoost on full data
full_train <- data
full_train$adopter <- as.numeric(as.character(full_train$adopter))
train_us_xgb <- full_train
x_train <- as.matrix(train_us_xgb %>% select(-adopter))
y_train <- train_us_xgb$adopter
x_test_unlabeled <- as.matrix(unlabeled)

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_train, label = y_train)
dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_test_unlabeled)

final_xgb <- xgboost(data = dtrain,
                     objective = "binary:logistic",
                     nrounds = best$nround,
                     max_depth = 5,
                     eta = 0.1,
                     eval_metric = "logloss",
                     verbose = 0)

xgb_pred <- predict(final_xgb, dtest)

#Ensemble and threshold
avg_pred <- (rf_pred + xgb_pred) / 2
final_pred <- ifelse(avg_pred > best$threshold, 1, 0)

#Export for submission
submission <- data.frame(user_id = user_ids, prediction = final_pred)
write.csv(submission, "Team-13-Submission-ROSE.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#GBM with fixed threshold (0.32) and IG-selected features
#Score: .1230 (on unseen data)

library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(gbm)
library(ROSE)
library(FSelectorRcpp)

set.seed(123)

#Load and prepare labeled data
data <- read.csv("LabelData.csv")
data$adopter <- as.factor(data$adopter)
data <- data %>% mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)

#Select top 20 features using Information Gain
ig_scores <- information_gain(adopter ~ ., data)
ig_scores <- as_tibble(ig_scores)

top_features_ig <- ig_scores %>%
  arrange(desc(importance)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:20) %>%
  pull(attributes)

#Subset data to top features
data <- data %>%
  select(all_of(c(top_features_ig, "adopter"))) %>%
  mutate(adopter = as.numeric(as.character(adopter)))

#Undersample using seed 42
sampled_data <- ovun.sample(adopter ~ ., data = data, method = "under",
                            N = floor(nrow(data) * 0.2), seed = 42)$data

#Train GBM model with AdaBoost loss
gbm_model <- gbm(adopter ~ ., data = sampled_data,
                 distribution = "adaboost",
                 n.trees = 150,
                 interaction.depth = 3,
                 shrinkage = 0.05,
                 verbose = FALSE)

#Predict on full labeled data to validate
probs <- predict(gbm_model, newdata = data, n.trees = 150, type = "response")
preds <- ifelse(probs > 0.32, 1, 0)

cm <- confusionMatrix(factor(preds), factor(data$adopter), mode = "prec_recall", positive = "1")
cat("Final F1 on labeled data:", round(as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"]), 4), "\n")

#Prepare test data
test_data <- read.csv("UnlabelData.csv") %>% select(all_of(top_features_ig))

#Predict on test data with fixed threshold 0.32
test_probs <- predict(gbm_model, newdata = test_data, n.trees = 150, type = "response")
test_preds <- ifelse(test_probs > 0.32, 1, 0)

#Export final predictions
write.csv(data.frame(user_id = read.csv("UnlabelData.csv")$user_id,
                     adopter = test_preds), "Team-13-Submission-4.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
